# bodyMuscles

SVG muscle paths copied from https://github.com/vulovix/body-muscles
(commit `15c8085ee97cb94c51f92c75224416b15f955b5c`), license Apache-2.0
(see `LICENSE` and `NOTICE`).

Taken from upstream: `muscles.front.ts`, `muscles.back.ts`, `types.ts`, `LICENSE`, `NOTICE`.
Not taken: `index.ts`, `muscle-groups.ts`.

Changed: the imports in `muscles.front.ts` and `muscles.back.ts` (they compile
standalone) and a license/attribution header on each `.ts` file; `types.ts` is
rewritten locally. Nothing else, path data is unchanged.
